text.ecology.actor.fen-pail.name: peat-bank pail keeper
text.ecology.actor.fen-pail.capability: puts out visible fire with three pails
text.ecology.actor.fen-pail.counterplay: draw away from water work or use smoke and a side causeway
text.ecology.actor.fen-cinder.name: cut-bank cinder thrower
text.ecology.actor.fen-cinder.capability: ignites a warned resin feed, then uses a sling lane
text.ecology.actor.fen-cinder.counterplay: wet the feed, interrupt preparation, or close its sightline
text.ecology.actor.fen-lynx.name: reedbank lynx
text.ecology.actor.fen-lynx.capability: hunts exposed fen hares and tracks noise into reeds
text.ecology.actor.fen-lynx.counterplay: lead it toward prey or break sight beyond its reed shelter
text.ecology.actor.fen-hare.name: long-eared fen hare
text.ecology.actor.fen-hare.capability: flees visible hunters, moving the lynx's attention
text.ecology.actor.fen-hare.counterplay: keep distance to watch it or use its flight as a distraction
text.ecology.actor.fen-bracer.name: raised-bank brace ward
text.ecology.actor.fen-bracer.capability: repairs warned supports before guarding the causeway
text.ecology.actor.fen-bracer.counterplay: draw it to a damaged support or approach from the drain
text.ecology.actor.fen-recoverer.name: reed-pack recoverer
text.ecology.actor.fen-recoverer.capability: retrieves visible dropped equipment and leaves by its home route
text.ecology.actor.fen-recoverer.counterplay: secure dropped goods or intercept its loaded retreat
text.ecology.actor.gorge-cutter.name: scaffold cord cutter
text.ecology.actor.gorge-cutter.capability: cuts warned floor support, then takes a side approach
text.ecology.actor.gorge-cutter.counterplay: brace the marked support or disrupt the cutting stance
text.ecology.actor.gorge-escort.name: two-bridge escort
text.ecology.actor.gorge-escort.capability: stays with visible injured carriers and opposes cargo raiders
text.ecology.actor.gorge-escort.counterplay: separate the escort from its ally or use the other bridge
text.ecology.actor.gorge-surgeon.name: cutworks field surgeon
text.ecology.actor.gorge-surgeon.capability: uses two dressings on observed wounded allies
text.ecology.actor.gorge-surgeon.counterplay: interrupt the approach or force its supplies to be spent
text.ecology.actor.gorge-marmot.name: shelf marmot
text.ecology.actor.gorge-marmot.capability: warns of hunters by abandoning an exposed rock shelf
text.ecology.actor.gorge-marmot.counterplay: observe at a distance or follow the direction of its flight
text.ecology.actor.gorge-cat.name: scree hunting cat
text.ecology.actor.gorge-cat.capability: hunts across scree without losing footing; weak hearing
text.ecology.actor.gorge-cat.counterplay: use a solid sight break or put prey between it and the route
text.ecology.actor.gorge-caller.name: cliff signal caller
text.ecology.actor.gorge-caller.capability: spends two signals on wavering allies and raises a group alarm
text.ecology.actor.gorge-caller.counterplay: break the signal lane or force a withdrawal before reinforcement
text.ecology.actor.terrace-drainer.name: field ditch keeper
text.ecology.actor.terrace-drainer.capability: drains observed deep patches using three stop boards
text.ecology.actor.terrace-drainer.counterpla: draw toward a flooded side field or travel along the dry bank
text.ecology.actor.terrace-kiln.name: kiln mouth sling ward
text.ecology.actor.terrace-kiln.capability: feeds a warned kiln mouth and denies the firing lane
text.ecology.actor.terrace-kiln.counterplay: wet the marked fuel or pass crosswind behind the kiln
text.ecology.actor.terrace-hare.name: seed-field hare
text.ecology.actor.terrace-hare.capability: crosses cultivated rows while fleeing visible orchard hunters
text.ecology.actor.terrace-hare.counterplay: leave it quiet or exploit its flight to draw the hunter
text.ecology.actor.terrace-thief.name: seed-sack taker
text.ecology.actor.terrace-thief.capability: collects abandoned seed sacks and escapes through irrigation paths
text.ecology.actor.terrace-thief.counterplay: block its escape or make the sack too risky to retrieve
text.ecology.actor.terrace-netter.name: harvest net escort
text.ecology.actor.terrace-netter.capability: escorts distressed carriers and telegraphs a restraining lane
text.ecology.actor.terrace-netter.counterplay: step out of the marked net or separate escort and carrier
text.ecology.actor.terrace-fox.name: orchard fox
text.ecology.actor.terrace-fox.capability: hunts seed-field hares around rows of dense growth
text.ecology.actor.terrace-fox.counterplay: draw it onto prey or use the irrigation sight breaks
text.ecology.actor.estuary-drainer.name: thaw-board runner
text.ecology.actor.estuary-drainer.capability: drains standing thaw water before taking a side route
text.ecology.actor.estuary-drainer.counterpla: use frozen ground or divert it toward deeper water
text.ecology.actor.estuary-caller.name: shelter line caller
text.ecology.actor.estuary-caller.capability: signals distant allies; weak hearing in shelter
text.ecology.actor.estuary-caller.counterplay: break the visible lane or approach through crosswind cover
text.ecology.actor.estuary-hunter.name: grey channel hunter
text.ecology.actor.estuary-hunter.capability: hunts snow hares over dry gravel and seasonal ice
text.ecology.actor.estuary-hunter.counterplay: thaw a crossing or distract it with fleeing prey
text.ecology.actor.estuary-hare.name: gravel snow hare
text.ecology.actor.estuary-hare.capability: flees toward its gravel shelter, exposing the hunter's route
text.ecology.actor.estuary-hare.counterplay: watch from beyond its sight or draw the hunter across the braid
text.ecology.actor.estuary-escort.name: net-loft withdrawing bow
text.ecology.actor.estuary-escort.capability: covers a loaded ally and shoots while withdrawing
text.ecology.actor.estuary-escort.counterplay: cut its sightline or take cover while closing the useful range
text.ecology.actor.estuary-mender.name: cold-net field mender
text.ecology.actor.estuary-mender.capability: uses two dressings before returning to shelter
text.ecology.actor.estuary-mender.counterplay: force separate injuries or deny the visible treatment route
text.ecology.actor.hearth-sluice-runner.name: sluice pail runner
text.ecology.actor.hearth-sluice-runner.capab: spends three pails on fire threatening a public bank
text.ecology.actor.hearth-sluice-runner.count: draw it away from the bank or exhaust its visible pails
text.ecology.actor.hearth-rope-cutter.name: ferry-rope cutter
text.ecology.actor.hearth-rope-cutter.capabil: warns before cutting a ferry brace and then takes the meadow flank
text.ecology.actor.hearth-rope-cutter.counter: brace the marked rope or interrupt the cutter from the bank loop
text.ecology.actor.hearth-meadow-kite.name: flood-meadow kite
text.ecology.actor.hearth-meadow-kite.capabil: descends on a visible dropped food or light tool
text.ecology.actor.hearth-meadow-kite.counter: secure dropped goods or use the descent to reveal the meadow patrol
text.ecology.actor.coast-wreck-gull.name: storm-wreck gull
text.ecology.actor.coast-wreck-gull.capabilit: takes exposed light salvage from the ebb road
text.ecology.actor.coast-wreck-gull.counterpl: pack the salvage or let its flight expose the landward gully
text.ecology.actor.coast-chain-mender.name: ebb-chain mender
text.ecology.actor.coast-chain-mender.capabil: repairs a warned wreck-chain support before covering withdrawal
text.ecology.actor.coast-chain-mender.counter: damage a different support or separate the mender from its ward
text.ecology.actor.coast-brine-pourer.name: brine-sluice pourer
text.ecology.actor.coast-brine-pourer.capabil: drains one deep flat before holding its narrow outlet
text.ecology.actor.coast-brine-pourer.counter: freeze the shallow cut or approach over fixed dune cover
text.ecology.actor.forest-cinder-crow.name: cinder-feeding crow
text.ecology.actor.forest-cinder-crow.capabil: carries small abandoned objects from cooling burn ground
text.ecology.actor.forest-cinder-crow.counter: secure the object or follow its flight toward the ash cache
text.ecology.actor.forest-well-runner.name: coppice well runner
text.ecology.actor.forest-well-runner.capabil: quenches a watched medicine boundary with carried buckets
text.ecology.actor.forest-well-runner.counter: draw the runner downwind or spend its buckets on a decoy fire
text.ecology.actor.forest-coppice-escort.name: charcoal sledge escort
text.ecology.actor.forest-coppice-escort.capa: keeps beside an injured or loaded charcoal carrier
text.ecology.actor.forest-coppice-escort.coun: pull the escort from the sledge or cross through wet coppice
text.ecology.actor.upland-lantern-taker.name: quarry-lamp taker
text.ecology.actor.upland-lantern-taker.capab: retrieves dropped lamps and tools before climbing for shelter
text.ecology.actor.upland-lantern-taker.count: keep light in the pack or block the nearest aligned stair
text.ecology.actor.upland-face-bracer.name: moving-face brace hand
text.ecology.actor.upland-face-bracer.capabil: seats a warned quarry support before holding two-pace measure
text.ecology.actor.upland-face-bracer.counter: force work at a second crack or enter inside the brace
text.ecology.actor.upland-crag-goat.name: bell-shelf crag goat
text.ecology.actor.upland-crag-goat.capabilit: flees a disturbed shelf and exposes the hunter's upper path
text.ecology.actor.upland-crag-goat.counterpl: watch from below or use its flight to draw the cave hound
text.ecology.actor.fen-peat-raker.name: dry-peat spark raker
text.ecology.actor.fen-peat-raker.capability: warns before feeding dry peat then circles by a wet cut
text.ecology.actor.fen-peat-raker.counterplay: wet the marked peat or interrupt from the raised walk
text.ecology.actor.fen-board-mender.name: bog-island board mender
text.ecology.actor.fen-board-mender.capabilit: repairs a failing inhabited walk before defending it
text.ecology.actor.fen-board-mender.counterpl: damage an empty branch or approach through the drain
text.ecology.actor.fen-marsh-harrier.name: low-reed marsh harrier
text.ecology.actor.fen-marsh-harrier.capabili: hunts disturbed fen hares across open water margins
text.ecology.actor.fen-marsh-harrier.counterp: lead it toward sheltered prey or disappear into dense reeds
text.ecology.actor.gorge-hoist-thief.name: dropped-hoist tackle thief
text.ecology.actor.gorge-hoist-thief.capabili: retrieves a dropped tool then escapes by the lower bridge
text.ecology.actor.gorge-hoist-thief.counterp: secure the tackle or close the lower switchback
text.ecology.actor.gorge-lime-bracer.name: lime-cut scaffold bracer
text.ecology.actor.gorge-lime-bracer.capabili: repairs a warned scaffold while lime smoke obscures the lane
text.ecology.actor.gorge-lime-bracer.counterp: clear the smoke or threaten a second unsupported bay
text.ecology.actor.gorge-raven.name: cutwall raven
text.ecology.actor.gorge-raven.capability: takes a light dropped object to an elevated ledge
text.ecology.actor.gorge-raven.counterplay: secure the object or use the ledge flight as a cache clue
text.ecology.actor.terrace-rill-dogger.name: seed-rill stop-board hand
text.ecology.actor.terrace-rill-dogger.capabi: drains one flooded seed row before guarding its board
text.ecology.actor.terrace-rill-dogger.counte: redirect water to another row or approach through the kiln lee
text.ecology.actor.terrace-ash-thief.name: fired-clay tally thief
text.ecology.actor.terrace-ash-thief.capabili: takes a dropped account or tool through irrigation cover
text.ecology.actor.terrace-ash-thief.counterp: keep the account packed or close the dry terrace exit
text.ecology.actor.terrace-rook.name: kiln-field rook
text.ecology.actor.terrace-rook.capability: collects light objects from cooling kiln margins
text.ecology.actor.terrace-rook.counterplay: secure the object or follow it toward a hidden firing shelf
text.ecology.actor.estuary-ice-bracer.name: thaw-channel ice bracer
text.ecology.actor.estuary-ice-bracer.capabil: seats a marked channel stake before holding the crossing
text.ecology.actor.estuary-ice-bracer.counter: thaw the alternate braid or enter inside its long brace
text.ecology.actor.estuary-wreck-taker.name: drift-store wreck taker
text.ecology.actor.estuary-wreck-taker.capabi: retrieves exposed winter stores and flees over firm gravel
text.ecology.actor.estuary-wreck-taker.counte: secure the store or block the gravel shelter route
text.ecology.actor.estuary-ice-otter.name: ice-channel otter
text.ecology.actor.estuary-ice-otter.capabili: hunts fleeing gravel hares but leaves deep salted current
text.ecology.actor.estuary-ice-otter.counterp: draw it after prey or break contact across a brined opening
text.ecology.actor.hearth-sluice-duellist.cap: warns before cutting the next ferry brace and holds its reach lane
text.ecology.actor.hearth-sluice-duellist.cou: brace the marked support or enter inside the long weapon
text.ecology.actor.coast-shingle-crab.name: shingle-shell crab
text.ecology.actor.coast-shingle-crab.capabil: waits under salt ridges before striking at a crossing shadow
text.ecology.actor.coast-shingle-crab.counter: circle on firm dune ground or leave its feeding ridge
text.ecology.actor.forest-ash-trapper.name: ashfall snare hand
text.ecology.actor.forest-ash-trapper.capabil: lights a short cinder line and shoots from root cover
text.ecology.actor.forest-ash-trapper.counter: quench the line or close through an unburnt canopy gap
text.ecology.actor.cairn-bell-shrike.name: bellwood shrike
text.ecology.actor.cairn-bell-shrike.capabili: carries exposed scraps toward a high warning bell
text.ecology.actor.cairn-bell-shrike.counterp: pack the scrap or follow the flight to its exposed roost
text.ecology.actor.mire-peat-tusker.name: peat-bank tusker
text.ecology.actor.mire-peat-tusker.capabilit: charges when close sound crosses its raised feeding bank
text.ecology.actor.mire-peat-tusker.counterpl: use reed cover or break sound across the blackwater braid
text.ecology.actor.gorge-span-harrier.name: span-toll harrier
text.ecology.actor.gorge-span-harrier.capabil: takes an abandoned tool after a warned crossbow shot
text.ecology.actor.gorge-span-harrier.counter: recover the tool first or use the lower fault pocket
text.ecology.actor.terrace-kiln-slinger.name: kiln-cinder slinger
text.ecology.actor.terrace-kiln-slinger.capab: lights its kiln fuel then denies the clay-row turn
text.ecology.actor.terrace-kiln-slinger.count: quench the fuel or force a close dry-terrace approach
text.ecology.actor.estuary-glaze-wolf.name: glaze-pelt wolf
text.ecology.actor.estuary-glaze-wolf.capabil: tracks a thaw channel and circles on firm ice
text.ecology.actor.estuary-glaze-wolf.counter: cross salted water or hold a narrow sounding point
text.ecology.actor.hearth-levee-warden.name: willow-levee brace ward
text.ecology.actor.hearth-levee-warden.capabi: sets a brace into a warned bank seam before holding the dry approach
text.ecology.actor.hearth-levee-warden.counte: draw it to a second seam or enter inside the planted brace
text.ecology.actor.coast-salt-marten.name: salt-shelf marten
text.ecology.actor.coast-salt-marten.capabili: carries bright dropped tackle from a dry oyster shelf
text.ecology.actor.coast-salt-marten.counterp: pack the tackle or follow its run to the sheltered shelf
text.ecology.actor.forest-briar-slinger.name: briar-line cinder slinger
text.ecology.actor.forest-briar-slinger.capab: feeds a warned cinder line from behind a thorn screen
text.ecology.actor.forest-briar-slinger.count: wet the marked brush or close through the unburnt side
text.ecology.actor.upland-scree-porter.name: scree-channel porter
text.ecology.actor.upland-scree-porter.capabi: clears loose chips from a melt run before taking the outer ledge
text.ecology.actor.upland-scree-porter.counte: hold the narrow ledge or turn it toward a deeper channel
text.ecology.actor.fen-rush-keeper.name: rush-bank brace keeper
text.ecology.actor.fen-rush-keeper.capability: pins a soft bank before guarding the raised reed walk
text.ecology.actor.fen-rush-keeper.counterpla: draw it toward a second soft edge or come through the drain
text.ecology.actor.gorge-fault-hound.name: fault-shelf hound
text.ecology.actor.gorge-fault-hound.capabili: tracks quarry noise then circles through the fault pocket
text.ecology.actor.gorge-fault-hound.counterp: break sound across the ledge or hold the narrow shelf
text.ecology.actor.terrace-clay-watch.name: clay-bank signal watch
text.ecology.actor.terrace-clay-watch.capabil: calls a kiln-side warning after spotting movement on a dry terrace
text.ecology.actor.terrace-clay-watch.counter: break the line of sight or force the warning from a covered bank
text.ecology.actor.estuary-brine-cutter.name: brine-channel cutter
text.ecology.actor.estuary-brine-cutter.capab: opens a shallow brine cut before holding its firm ice margin
text.ecology.actor.estuary-brine-cutter.count: cross the salted water or approach through the wind-scoured bar
text.frontier.elite.fen-marshal.name: Veyra Reedlock
text.frontier.elite.fen-marshal.capability: Three counted releases flood a marked low lane; higher ground and the spill control remain usable.
text.frontier.elite.fen-marshal.counterplay: leave the marked lane, use height, or dog the regional spill
text.frontier.elite.fen-stack.name: smouldering peat crown
text.frontier.elite.fen-stack.capability: Dry rack fuel feeds smoke before a warned support fails; water stops the heat chain.
text.frontier.elite.fen-stack.counterplay: quench the rack, shelter below, or cool it through the spill
text.frontier.elite.gorge-cordmaster.name: Darrin Splitspan
text.frontier.elite.gorge-cordmaster.capabili: Marks visible floor support before cutting, then moves toward a higher escape stair.
text.frontier.elite.gorge-cordmaster.counterp: brace the marked support, interrupt the cut, or tension the tailrace
text.frontier.elite.gorge-convoy.name: counterweight convoy foreman
text.frontier.elite.gorge-convoy.capability: Nearby escort bodies take two harm from strikes on the foreman; one hoist signal rallies them.
text.frontier.elite.gorge-convoy.counterplay: pull the escort apart, defeat its helpers, or publish the tailrace control
text.frontier.elite.terrace-reeve.name: Elsa Kilnmark
text.frontier.elite.terrace-reeve.capability: Three charcoal charges ignite a warned crosswind line; wet cells do not light.
text.frontier.elite.terrace-reeve.counterplay: pour on the fuel, move crosswind, or send the release to the kilns
text.frontier.elite.terrace-shutters.name: counterweighted kiln shutters
text.frontier.elite.terrace-shutters.capabili: Alternates loose cover across two marked lanes; the blades themselves telegraph a sweep.
text.frontier.elite.terrace-shutters.counterp: cross a different lane, brace the linkage, or operate the kiln release
text.frontier.elite.estuary-pilot.name: Tova Frostwake
text.frontier.elite.estuary-pilot.capability: Counted brine breaks thin ice into current; unfrozen ground instead takes salt slurry.
text.frontier.elite.estuary-pilot.counterplay: leave the marked sheet, use cleats and a light load, or release the ice boom
text.frontier.elite.estuary-drum.name: loaded net-haul drum
text.frontier.elite.estuary-drum.capability: Marks a place for the haul, then pulls an unmoved bearer toward deep water; heavy loads suffer longer restraint.
text.frontier.elite.estuary-drum.counterplay: leave the mark, guard the haul, or cut the material linkage
text.frontier.elite.hearth-lockhand.name: Ysolde Lockhand
text.frontier.elite.hearth-lockhand.capabilit: A counted backwash fills three paces of lane and pushes an unguarded bearer off its marked footing.
text.frontier.elite.hearth-lockhand.counterpl: leave the marked lane, guard the release, or dog the public sluice
text.frontier.elite.coast-wreckward.name: Bran Wreckward
text.frontier.elite.coast-wreckward.capabilit: Marks one physical ground item before taking it; defeat or witnessed settlement releases the same object.
text.frontier.elite.coast-wreckward.counterpl: pack the marked good, block the approach, or present the witnessed wreck account
text.frontier.elite.forest-ashstep.name: Mara Ashstep
text.frontier.elite.forest-ashstep.capability: A warned break across three paces extinguishes useful flame but leaves obscuring ash where dry fuel stood.
text.frontier.elite.forest-ashstep.counterpla: move the fire, use a wet boundary, or preserve the medicine coppice
text.frontier.elite.upland-bellrope.name: Orren Bellrope
text.frontier.elite.upland-bellrope.capabilit: Marks one unprotected floor before dropping loose visible cover; remaining in place risks a guarded blunt fall.
text.frontier.elite.upland-bellrope.counterpl: leave the mark, stand under public structure, or ring the honest bell
text.frontier.elite.fen-pump-train.name: backwater pump train
text.frontier.elite.fen-pump-train.capability: Drains a warned three-pace stretch of water into its pump bed, leaving wet soil as slowing mud.
text.frontier.elite.fen-pump-train.counterpla: flood a second opening, brace the pump bed, or dog the regional spill
text.frontier.elite.gorge-wedge-crane.name: cantilever wedge crane
text.frontier.elite.gorge-wedge-crane.capabil: Shifts loose cover onto a warned place without sealing the alternate bridge.
text.frontier.elite.gorge-wedge-crane.counter: take the other span, brace the linkage, or tension the public tailrace
text.frontier.elite.terrace-slip-wheel.name: clay-slip spread wheel
text.frontier.elite.terrace-slip-wheel.capabi: Spreads shallow clay slurry across a warned line; an unguarded bearer becomes briefly mud-burdened.
text.frontier.elite.terrace-slip-wheel.counte: leave the line, guard in place, or operate the kiln release
text.frontier.elite.estuary-ice-boom.name: loaded ice-boom capstan
text.frontier.elite.estuary-ice-boom.capabili: Freezes warned fresh shallows or shifts loose timber cover where no water remains.
text.frontier.elite.estuary-ice-boom.counterp: salt the water, cut the linkage, or release the public ice boom
text.ecology.reason.hazard: flame or a creaking support threatens its present footing
text.ecology.reason.hunter: a visible hunter or approaching courier disturbed its feeding
text.ecology.reason.preserve: visible material damage calls for its remaining {duty} supplies
text.ecology.reason.alter: its assigned material target is in sight and the dispute is active
text.ecology.reason.treat: an observed ally needs its last field dressing
text.ecology.reason.rally: an ally's visible distress takes priority over pursuit
text.ecology.reason.retrieve: a physical abandoned item is visible, not an unopened reward
text.ecology.reason.rival: {target} is visibly intruding on its {ecology} interest
text.ecology.reason.escort: a visible carrier or wounded ally needs a physical escort
text.ecology.intent.open_door: opens a working door before passing
text.ecology.intent.graze: feeds within its shelter; not hunting the courier
text.ecology.intent.rival_prepare: turns a warned strike on {rival}; a retreat breaks the attack
text.ecology.intent.ally_disrupted: disrupted while an ally tends the withdrawal
text.ecology.intent.prepare: prepares to {action} at {position}; water, bracing or interruption can answer
text.ecology.result.rival_empty: The {actor}'s rival strike meets empty ground.
text.ecology.result.rival_strike: The {actor} strikes its rival {rival}; {health} health remains.
text.ecology.result.carry: The {actor} {intent}; the item can be recovered before escape.
text.frontier.intent.control_removed: the worked regional control has removed the disputed leverage
text.frontier.intent.withdraw: withdraws injured with the unresolved working claim
text.frontier.intent.recover: resets its working charge; the recovery leaves an opening
text.frontier.intent.depleted: has spent its last working charge
text.frontier.intent.wait: waits for entry into its eight-pace working lane
text.frontier.intent.prepare: prepares {mode} at {position}; one action to leave, interrupt or secure the control
text.frontier.intent.blocked: abandons the prepared action behind blocked geometry
text.frontier.intent.return: returns once, provisioned by the local claim; remembers the earlier retreat
text.frontier.result.stand_down: {actor} stands down: the control or physical linkage has been secured.
text.frontier.result.withdraw: {actor} withdraws; a surviving claimant may seek one later hearing.
text.frontier.result.depleted: {actor} has no charge left; the working threat ends.
text.frontier.result.blocked: {actor}'s marked operation is blocked by the changed sightline.
text.frontier.result.no_footing: {actor}'s operation finds no sound material footing.
text.frontier.result.guard_intercept: {helper} physically takes {amount} harm for the convoy
text.frontier.result.surge: Water surges across three paces; openings carry it below and wet loads now matter.
text.frontier.result.smoulder_quenched: The quenched peat crown cannot carry flame into its rack.
text.frontier.result.smoulder: The dry peat crown smoulders; rising smoke precedes a two-action support warning.
text.frontier.result.sever_fall: The cut support will fall in two actions; brace it or move through a different level.
text.frontier.result.sever_weaken: The first cut exposes a weakened brace; the next cut can drop it unless repaired.
text.frontier.result.sever_protected: The marked public stair or store has independent support; the cord cut cannot drop it.
text.frontier.result.convoy: The hoist signal gathers the visible escort; separate its bodies to expose the foreman.
text.frontier.result.firing: The charcoal charge lights {count} dry marked cells; water defeats the other patches.
text.frontier.result.shutters: Counterweights shift loose cover across the marked lane; routes stay passable.
text.frontier.result.brine_frozen: Brine breaks the marked ice into deep current.
text.frontier.result.brine: Brine salts the marked footing; exposed gear and aiming face abrasive slurry.
text.frontier.result.backwash: The counted backwash fills three cells; guard holds footing while openings accept the fresh water.
text.frontier.result.salvage_empty: The marked property has moved or is already secured; the salvage claim takes nothing.
text.frontier.result.salvage: The wreckward takes the exact marked object; interception, defeat or witnessed terms can recover it.
text.frontier.result.firebreak: The warned firebreak clears {broken} patches of fuel and leaves ash across three paces.
text.frontier.result.counterfall: Loose stone drops only onto the warned unprotected floor; it becomes passable cover, not a sealed route.
text.frontier.result.siphon: The pump shifts {moved} water depth into its physical bed; the drained line remains muddy.
text.frontier.result.lever: The cantilever shifts loose passable cover onto the warning mark; the alternate span remains open.
text.frontier.result.slip: Clay slip coats three warned cells; an unguarded bearer on the mark is briefly burdened.
text.frontier.result.boom: The ice boom freezes {frozen} fresh shallows and shifts {cover} loose, passable timber screens.
text.frontier.result.haul_caught: The warned haul catches the bearer; load lengthens restraint beside the wet opening.
text.frontier.result.haul_miss: The haul crosses its old mark; reposition or guard denies the net.
text.frontier.record.install: {actor} now contests the later work at {x},{y}, z{z}; watch its apparatus and learn its terms.
text.frontier.record.reward: A physical claim reward remains at {x},{y}, z{z}; I opens the ground source.
text.frontier.record.return: {actor} used one {commodity} lot to return to the unresolved claim after retreat; old injuries and losses remain.
text.forecast.counter.default: move, use cover, guard, or interrupt
text.frontier.status.slip.cause: the warned clay-slip line caught an unguarded step
text.frontier.status.slip.consequence: guard or leave the slurry to recover ordinary footing
text.frontier.status.haul.cause: a loaded net drum caught the marked place
text.frontier.status.haul.consequence: guard and movement suffer; move free or wait out the haul
